title: The Connected Acyclic Tree Structural Check
statement:
Given an undirected graph of V vertices labeled 0 to V - 1 and E edges, determine whether the graph forms a valid tree.
An undirected graph is a tree if and only if:
1. It is fully connected (all V vertices in a single connected component).
2. It has no cycles (which implies E == V - 1).

Print YES if the graph is a valid tree, otherwise print NO.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers V and E.
Next E lines: Two integers u and v indicating an undirected edge.

sampleCases.explanation: Graph is connected and has no cycles.
